items.title: Winard Harper interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 10, 2014
items.q: I never met Duke Ellington or Mingus.

ctx.x: If you had a little audience and you were trying to get them turned on to jazz, and you had an hour or something and you had a CD player, what kind of recordings would you pick from jazz history?

I would try to squeeze in as much real live recordings. Some Louis Armstrong, some Duke Ellington, Billie Holiday of course and then probably get to some Art Blakey and the Jazz Messengers. Cannonball. I mean there would be so much I would try to pack in. And I would try to pick a lot of those things that I think brought me along, that turned me on to the music. Clifford Brown and Max Roach. But singers. Singers I think is always a good way of coming in.
[Phone ringing. Excuse me for a moment]
